case_name: Add a logo or text overlay
title: Append a Clean End Card
tests: Tests appending an accurately timed end card with exact text while preserving the complete source clip and its audio.

faults.what: The black end card is already visible at 5.6 seconds, before the requested 7-second source clip should finish, so it replaces or cuts short part of the original footage and is not confined to the final 2 seconds.

judge.summary: The end card has the correct, readable centered text, but appears too early and cuts short the requested cockpit footage.

must_haves.item: The entire original cockpit clip plays before the end card, without being replaced or shortened.
must_haves.why: The output shows the end card at 5.6 seconds, although all 7 seconds of cockpit footage should precede it.

must_haves.item: A solid black end card occupies only the final 2 seconds of the 9-second output.
must_haves.why: The card is visible at both 5.6 and 7.9 seconds, including a time before the intended 7-second start.

must_haves.item: The end card reads exactly 'Ready for takeoff?' with '@flightschool' on the line below.
must_haves.why: Both requested strings are spelled correctly and arranged on two lines in the requested order.

must_haves.item: Both lines are white, centered, fully visible, and comfortably readable.
must_haves.why: The white text is large, centered, and fully contained within the black frame.

must_haves.item: Original cockpit audio is preserved during the source footage, followed by silence during the end card.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio summary confirms speech is present but does not establish complete source-audio preservation or silence during the end card.
